show.description: Dr. Niraj Chandra and Dr. Sanya Chandra, once deeply in love, now stand at the crossroads of separation. As their children, Ayaan and Ahana, struggle to keep the family together, love, respect, and old wounds collide in an emotional journey of what it truly means to be a family.
